policies.positive_condition: An identifying reference to a general item/task list, an event calendar or schedule functioning as a collection, or a contact-record collection/address book. The collection role must be expressed; an item, activity, scheduling verb, punctuality property or generic storage container alone is insufficient. Music playlists and mail folders alone retain their specialized roles unless a separate general item/task-list role is expressed. Apply expressed-communicative-content scope.
policies.requested_unassigned_role_policy: Identify the collection role from the full utterance, not from a proper title or native intent. My calendar, the schedule queried for its entries, contacts used for record lookup/editing, address book and named shopping/task lists can qualify without recovering all entries. A calendar or schedule counts when used as an event/appointment collection, including asking what is on it or adding, deleting or clearing entries. Schedule as an operation verb, on schedule as punctuality, or a single appointment by itself does not establish a collection. Contacts counts when expressed as a contact-record collection, for example lookup in contacts or add an address to contacts. People described as contacts without a collection relation do not automatically qualify. A contact collection does not by itself imply a human person or an attribute field. Music playlists, a music library and mail-storage folders/inbox are not automatically general lists merely because they contain items.
